name: web-hover-photo-fan-card-mountain-hike-with-meta-icons
title: White card 'Mountain Hike' with an arrow, three overlapping tilted mountain photos, a meta row (hours, km, difficulty) and a description
whatItIs: A white rounded card with a soft shadow, a bold title and a right arrow, three slightly rotated overlapping mountain photos with white borders (one lifted under a cursor), a row of icons with '~6 Hours', '8 km', 'Medium' and a short grey paragraph.
whatItMeans: Inviting and tactile; fanned photos suggest a stack you can flip through.
techniques: Fan overlapping photos with white borders.
Add a compact icon meta row.
Use a small arrow to indicate a link.

vocabulary.definition: Overlapping tilted photos spread like cards.
Icons with small facts such as time and distance.
An element rising when the cursor is over it.
A photo with a white frame.
